name: Radio Ham Percy

intro.text: CQ, CQ, anyone out there? Oh. It's you. Well, I'll take it. VP6 is the call-sign prefix for Pitcairn, and it makes people very excited in Ohio.

win: Signal lost. Over and out, and no hard feelings.
after: On a good night I can talk to forty countries before breakfast. The weather doesn't improve the chat, but the company does.
